name: Machir
bio: Machir was the son of Manasseh and father of Gilead, ancestor of the Gileadite clan within the tribe of Manasseh (Numbers 26:29). When Israel divided the land, Machir's descendants went to Gilead, captured it, and drove out the Amorites who lived there; Moses then gave Gilead to Machir, and he settled there (Numbers 32:39-40). Gilead later became the inheritance of the half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan, and Machir's name remained closely tied to that region in later Scripture (Deuteronomy 3:15; Joshua 17:1).
